test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 18 Nov 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.**

People don’t use this road much.

options.text: This road isn’t much used by people.
This road cannot be used much by people.
This road isn’t used much by public

solution:
The correct answer is** "This road isn't used much."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the active voice sentence "**People don’t use this road much**", the subject is "**People**" and the object is "**this road**".
 
• To convert this sentence into passive voice, we need to make the **object **"**this road**" the **subject **of the sentence and add the **auxiliary verb** "**isn't**" followed by the **past participle form** of the **main verb** "**used**".
 
• The subject "**People**" becomes the object of the preposition "**by**".
 
• The correct passive form is "**This road isn’t used much.**"

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• "**This road isn't much used by people**," is also in passive voice but includes the unnecessary word "much."
 
• "**This road cannot be used much by people**," changes the meaning of the sentence by adding "cannot."
 
• "**This road isn't used much by public**," is grammatically incorrect as "public" should be preceded by an article (e.g. "the public").
